pencereler.0-5: During take-off in Pensacola, an MD-88's left engine burst apart. Suddenly debris tore into
pencereler.5-12: the cabin and killed two passengers. The pilot aborted the take-off. Part of the fan hub had fractured. The
pencereler.12-20: flaw had been created during manufacture. A crack grew from it over time. The airline's inspection didn't spot it. Engine inspection methods

segmentler.metin: Delta Air Lines Flight 1288 had its engine burst during take-off.
It took only a manufacturing flaw in the engine's fan hub.
So how could a manufacturing flaw in the engine's fan hub do this?
The answer is an uncontained engine failure sending hub debris into the cabin — and it is why engine manufacturing and inspection methods were tightened.
